scenarios.effect: Additional delivery provenance only; same original hash and obligation remain authoritative.

groundingExpectations.unresolvedAfterExplicitCorrectOriginalTe: May proceed if content supported and all business requirements satisfied.

word/line granularity, no fuzzy character repair
